interviews.speaker: Jens Harder
interviews.why: The process owner's own interview: describes the process, its scored impact grid, RTO, MTPD, failure causes, emergency operation and all resource dependencies.

interviews.speaker: Henning Barsch
interviews.why: The downstream process names raw material procurement as its upstream process and lists missing raw materials as a failure cause, confirming the dependency and the effect of a procurement outage.

owner.name: Jens Harder
owner.quote: It is a core process, and its process owner is purchasing management.

mtpd.speaker: Jens Harder
mtpd.reason: The interviewee stated it; the grid reaches 4 (image, operational) only at 168 h, the last horizon, and the owner set MTPD beyond it.

rto.quote: Raw material procurement has an RTO (recovery time objective) of 72 hours, because a standstill of the process beyond that time has considerable operational, financial, legal and image impacts.
rto.speaker: Jens Harder
rto.reason: The interviewee stated a 72 h recovery time objective.

rpo.quote: IT systems. Microsoft 365: RPO <24 h, RTO 72 h.
rpo.speaker: Jens Harder
rpo.reason: No process-level RPO was stated; orders run on Microsoft 365 whose RPO is <24 h, so a stricter RPO is not needed for the order data.

dependencies.heard: Microsoft 365 for ordering, e-mail and documentation
dependencies.quote: Office 365 is needed as the standard resource for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneDrive and Teams.

dependencies.heard: Microsoft SharePoint Online to exchange and store data
dependencies.quote: SharePoint is used to exchange and store data.

dependencies.heard: Buyers (2 in normal operation, 1 in emergency operation)
dependencies.quote: The buyer is responsible for choosing suitable suppliers, placing orders and making sure that the ordered products are delivered on time and in high quality.

dependencies.heard: Suppliers with framework contracts and open-market suppliers; they transport the goods and keep the cold chain
dependencies.quote: There are suppliers with framework contracts, bound long-term, who regularly deliver set quantities of raw materials and meat products, and suppliers on the open market, chosen as needed.

dependencies.heard: Interruption of transport routes or of the cold chain would make the process fail
dependencies.quote: interruption of transport routes or of the cold chain

dependencies.heard: Downstream process production and processing depends on delivered raw materials
dependencies.quote: Its upstream process is raw material procurement; the downstream process is order picking.

conflicts.about: MTPD: the grid (2025) gives 168 h by the method's rule, the draft says >168 h

sides.claim: 168 h (the method's rule over the grid, 2025)
sides.speaker: method

conflicts.why: The method derives the MTPD from the grid; the other figure is the thing to explain.

gaps.what: No process-level RPO for raw material procurement was stated; only the system RPOs of Microsoft 365 (<24 h) and SharePoint Online (<168 h) are known.
gaps.ask: How old may the order and supplier data be at the latest before resuming procurement after an outage?

gaps.what: In emergency operation one buyer runs the process remotely, but the workaround names no specific deputy: 'In an emergency somebody takes over; no name is given for who.'
gaps.ask: Who exactly deputises for the buyer in emergency operation, and is that person trained for it?
